user_prompt: I need to pull current production schedules and equipment status to finalize our procurement forecast for next quarter, and simultaneously submit a maintenance request for our assembly line since we're seeing performance degradation that needs urgent attention from our service team.

steps.step_name: Pull current production schedules and equipment status to finalize our procurement forecast for next quarter

args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 (READ payroll/compensation data)
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (INBOUND REST API for goods receipt), Procurement agents (ProcurementMatchingAgent evaluates vendor pricing/lead times/quality), OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine (sales opp→order), AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator (BOM/material changes)
- sap.crm: CRM - sales/marketing agents ONLY (OpportunityQualificationAdvisor, SalesCompensationOrchestrator, etc.) - NO performance analytics APIs
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - AGENTS ONLY (IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer, IncidentResponseCoordinator, ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator, SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator) - NO REST API for reading safety metrics
- sap.ariba: Procurement - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI (REST API for PO status + vendor monitoring), VendorInvoiceReconciliation, MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY (IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer, AssetProvisioningOrchestrator, ChangeAutomationOrchestrator, IncidentSafetyCoordinator, OccupationalSafetyIncidentCoordinator, VendorContractComplianceOrchestrator, ChangeReleaseCoordinator) - NO create API for maintenance submission
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents only
- my.mes: Manufacturing - ProductionQualityMonitor, EquipmentOEEAnalytics (REST API READ-ONLY: real-time machine metrics + ProductionOrder data), BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator, HazmatIncidentComplianceMonitor, ProductionChangeOrchestrator, SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator
- siemens.plm: PLM - SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator (material-to-vendor mappings, supplier performance metrics, vendor compliance), BOMComplianceValidator, EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning (engineering changes, material specs, design changes), QualityAssuranceAndDefectPrevention
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

PRODUCTION SCHEDULES & EQUIPMENT STATUS:
- my.mes:apiResource:EquipmentOEEAnalytics:v1 = PRIMARY for production schedules + equipment status
  - Capabilities: real-time machine performance metrics (availability, performance, quality), OEE calculations
  - Exposes: Machine entity type (equipment status) + ProductionOrder entity type (production schedules)
  - REST API (open access) - suitable for procurement forecasting by showing production capacity, timing, and equipment availability

PRODUCT SPECIFICATION CHANGES:
- siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1 = PRIMARY for product specification changes
  - Capabilities: coordinate BOM updates, evaluate change impact, track change status, synchronize engineering changes, assess engineering changes, initiate engineering change, manage material provisioning
  - Covers engineering changes across product lifecycle and material specifications
  - Automates approval workflows and synchronizes configuration updates

PRODUCT ECONOMICS ANALYSIS:
- siemens.plm:agent:SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1 = PRIMARY for product economics
  - Capabilities: supplier qualification, material-to-vendor mappings, vendor compliance monitoring, supplier performance metrics
  - Addresses both cost drivers (performance/quality metrics) and supplier dependencies (material mappings, compliance)
  - Works across product lifecycle for comprehensive economics view
